title: Skip Pass Shooting
description: Drive-and-kick footwork meets skip passing: swing the ball across the court and knock down the weak-side three in rhythm.
goal: Train the drive-kick-skip sequence: drive to collapse the defense, skip the ball to the weak side, and shoot it in rhythm.
setup: Set up three lines: a driver at the top, a skip passer on the wing, and a shooter in the opposite corner.
Driver starts with the ball; shooter starts with hands ready in the corner.
Rotate lines after each rep: driver to shooter, shooter to passer, passer to driver.

instructions.title: Drive to collapse
instructions.detail: Driver attacks the paint with two hard dribbles, forcing the help defense to commit.

instructions.title: Kick to the wing
instructions.detail: Driver jump-stops and kicks out to the wing passer — a crisp two-handed pass on target.

instructions.title: Skip across the court
instructions.detail: Wing catches and immediately skips the ball to the opposite corner — one quick swing, no extra dribbles.

instructions.title: Catch and shoot in rhythm
instructions.detail: Corner shooter catches with feet set and shoots the three in one motion; follow your shot and rotate lines.

instructions.title: Run 10 makes per player
instructions.detail: Each player shoots until they make 10 corner threes, then the drill flips to the other side of the floor.

coachingPoints: The skip pass must be flat and fast — a lobbed skip gives the defense time to recover.
Shooter: be shot-ready before the catch, not after — feet set, knees loaded.
Driver: jump-stop under control; out-of-control drives create turnovers, not open shots.
Passer: catch and skip in one motion — every extra dribble lets the closeout arrive.
commonMistakes: Throwing a soft, high skip pass — it gets deflected or arrives too late for a rhythm shot.
Shooter catching flat-footed — if you're not ready before the catch, the closeout beats you.
progression: Add a closeout defender sprinting at the shooter, require the shooter to shot-fake and drive on the closeout, or skip from a live pick-and-roll instead of a set drive.
regression: Shorten the skip to a wing-to-wing swing, shoot from 15 feet instead of three, or remove the drive and start from a stationary kickout.
gameApplication: Modern offenses generate threes through drive-and-kick skip passes — this drill trains the exact sequence that beats rotating defenses.
